description: Search the full satellite catalog (about 17,000 objects) by name, alias or NORAD number, best match first: an exact NORAD number, then the whole name, the start of the name or of each word, part of the number, anywhere in the name, and last near misses (so a small typo still finds it). Use it to turn a name like "SDO" or "NOAA 19" into a NORAD number for the other tools; names outside the popular list only resolve directly on an exact whole-name match. To find satellites by downlink kind, search with mode "radio" and the kind as the query (query "sstv"). Each result has noradId, name, url, hasKnownDownlinks and bands (the radio bands of its downlinks); no match is an empty list. For the popular satellites use list_satellites; for one satellite's facts and TLE use get_satellite.

limit.description: how many results to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

mode.description: "visual" (default): best name match first; "radio": satellites with known radio downlinks first among equally good matches. To list satellites with a kind of downlink, set mode "radio" and put the kind in query (e.g. query "sstv"); mode itself takes only "visual" or "radio".

query.description: a name, part of one, or a NORAD number, e.g. "sdo", "noaa 19", "25544". With mode "radio", a downlink kind as the whole query (e.g. "sstv", "aprs", "cw") lists satellites that have one.

name: search_satellites
title: Search satellites
